description: This file implements the InlineForkWait function for inlining fork/wait nodes in PyTorch's JIT compiler graphs, modifying and optimizing computation graphs by inlining asynchronous execution constructs.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents a computation graph in PyTorch's JIT compiler, with methods for manipulation.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a value in the computation graph, used for inputs, outputs, and intermediate data.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the computation graph, such as operations or control flow.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a block of nodes within the graph, allowing for structured code transformations.

methods.name: void InlineForkWait(Block * b,std::unordered_map<Value *,Value * > & future_remap)
methods.description: Recursive function that inlines fork/wait pairs within a graph block, replacing wait nodes with their futures and removing unnecessary fork/wait constructs.

methods.name: InlineForkWait (overload)
methods.description: Initializes the inlining process by creating a future_remap map and calling the recursive function on the graph's top-level block.
